model_annotation: The plot illustrates how the “Anteil Erwerbstätige in %” (share employed, in percent) varies with “Alter” (age) for four population groups distinguished by migration background. The x-axis is labeled “Alter,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 20 to 70 with major tick labels at 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, and 70 (10-year intervals). The y-axis is labeled “Anteil Erwerbstätige in %,” uses a linear scale from 0 to 100, and shows major ticks at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100 (20-percentage-point intervals). The black solid line with circular markers (“ohne Migrationshintergrund”) starts near 60% at age 20, rises to the low-to-mid 80% range by the late 20s/around 30, stays around the mid-to-high 80% through roughly ages 40–55, then declines after about 60 and drops sharply to around 10% by the late 60s and to roughly 5% at age 70. The medium-gray solid line with circular markers (“in Deutschland geboren”) begins around the mid-50% range at age 20, increases into the 70–80% range by the late 20s/30s, fluctuates mostly between about 70% and mid-80% through roughly ages 35–58, then declines after about 60 and falls to around 10–20% in the late 60s and to about 10% by age 70. The light-blue solid line with circular markers (“zugewandert bis 2009”) starts around the mid-30% range at age 20, jumps to around the mid-to-high 70% range in the early 20s, then generally fluctuates around roughly 60–70% through about ages 30–55, trends downward toward about 60% by around age 60, and then drops steeply after the early 60s to around 10–20% in the late 60s and to roughly 10% at age 70. The dark-blue solid line with circular markers (“zugewandert seit 2010”) begins near the high-30% range at age 20, rises into the 40–60% range through the 20s and 30s with noticeable oscillations, reaches values around the 60–70% range at several points in the 40s and 50s (including peaks near the upper 60s), then declines and becomes highly variable after about 60, dropping to around 20% in the mid-60s and reaching approximately 0% at about ages 67 and 70.
